categories.main_business_segments: Ministop Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the convenience store sector, with two main business segments: domestic operations in Japan and overseas operations in Vietnam. The domestic segment includes franchise and directly operated convenience stores, while the overseas segment focuses on franchise and direct store operations in Vietnam. The group also includes logistics operations supporting store supply chains.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages a franchise business model, proprietary store operation systems, and in-store food preparation methods, particularly for fast food and fresh products. It emphasizes operational efficiency through digitalization (e.g., POS, self-checkout, mobile ordering), in-store food processing (such as freshly made rice balls and soft-serve ice cream), and supply chain optimization. Product development focuses on both original and collaborative items, with attention to sustainability and health.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ministop serves general consumers seeking convenience, quality, and value, targeting urban and suburban populations in Japan and Vietnam. Key markets include daily shoppers, commuters, office workers (via unmanned stores), and families. The company also addresses corporate clients through office-based unmanned convenience solutions and e-commerce channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s core operations are in Japan, with a nationwide store network, and a growing presence in Vietnam, particularly in Ho Chi Minh City. As of February 2025, there were 1,848 stores in Japan and 182 in Vietnam. The company previously operated in other Asian countries but has since exited those markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ministop operates at the downstream end of the supply chain as a retailer, directly interfacing with end consumers. It also manages midstream logistics through its subsidiary, Network Service Co., which handles distribution to stores. The company is not involved in manufacturing but collaborates closely with suppliers and logistics partners.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include structural reform, digital transformation (OMO: Online Merges with Offline), expansion of the New Combo Store model, and sustainability initiatives (CO2, food loss, plastics reduction). R&D focuses on developing unique fast food and fresh products, enhancing store operations, and integrating digital services such as mobile apps, e-commerce, and unmanned stores. The company is also investing in human capital, diversity, and management system reforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through franchise royalties (based on gross profit or business profit sharing), direct store sales, and logistics services. Additional income streams include e-commerce, delivery services, digital advertising (in-store signage), and unmanned store solutions. The company also receives royalties from overseas franchise agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ministop competes with major Japanese convenience store chains such as Seven-Eleven, Lawson, and FamilyMart, as well as with supermarkets, drugstores, and fast-food outlets. It differentiates itself through its combo store model (combining convenience and fast food), in-store food preparation, and unique products like soft-serve ice cream. While smaller in scale than the top three, Ministop positions itself as an innovative, customer-centric, and community-oriented chain.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending February 2025, consolidated operating revenue was 87.5 billion yen, with a net loss attributable to parent company shareholders of 6.77 billion yen. The company has experienced fluctuating performance, with recent years marked by restructuring costs and impairment losses. Store count is stable in Japan and growing in Vietnam, but overall profitability remains a challenge as the company invests in transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ministop emphasizes 'deliciousness and convenience' as its core value, offering freshly prepared fast food, unique desserts (notably soft-serve ice cream), and a wide assortment of daily necessities. The New Combo Store model integrates digital and physical retail, providing a seamless customer experience. The company also highlights sustainability, community engagement, and health-conscious product development as key differentiators.
